name: min_wardrobe_items
note: REVIEW: start value. Below this many usable pieces (after the modesty / season / occasion filters) the verdict is given with LOW confidence: there is too little to pair the new piece with. Used by src/phase4/verdict.py.

name: far_from_style_cut
note: REVIEW: start value. Cosine similarity between the new piece and the user's taste vector (the mean of the wardrobe's FashionCLIP vectors) below which the app says the piece is far from the user's style. Chosen on the frozen golden wardrobe (backend/tests/golden/wardrobe.json): the 17 owned pieces score 0.55-0.79 (median 0.67), the 3 scans 0.70-0.74, and 3000 other PolyVore pieces have median 0.62; 0.50 flags none of the owned pieces and about 7% of the other pieces. Informs only: it never moves the verdict or the confidence.

name: budget_share
note: REVIEW: start value. A piece costing more than this share of the user's budget (profile budget_tnd) gets the over_budget note. Informs only: it never moves the verdict or the confidence.
